title: add CodeFileAdapter and update mime type mappings for code files
body:
## Fix TypeScript File Upload on macOS as well as other source code file types
### Problem Description
On macOS, TypeScript (.ts) files are incorrectly identified as MPEG Transport Stream video files with MIME type video/mp2t. This causes file uploads to fail with the error: "没有找到对应的文件适配器:video/mp2t" (No file adapter found for video/mp2t).
### This issue specifically affects:
TypeScript (.ts) files on macOS
File upload functionality in the chat interface
Code file handling and syntax highlighting
## Solution
The solution implements two layers of handling to ensure TypeScript files are correctly processed:
Added MIME type mapping for video/mp2t to CodeFileAdapter to handle misidentified TypeScript files
Added extension-based detection in FilePresenter.createFileAdapter() to explicitly handle .ts and .tsx files
## Technical Changes
Added mapping in mime.ts: map.set('video/mp2t', CodeFileAdapter)
Added extension-based file type detection in FilePresenter.ts
Added clear comments explaining the macOS-specific workaround
## Platform Compatibility Notes
macOS: Fixes the TypeScript file identification issue
Windows/Linux: No impact (these platforms correctly identify .ts files)
Tested on:
macOS Monterey 12.0
Windows 10
Ubuntu 20.04
Additional Context
This is a platform-specific workaround for macOS's MIME type detection behavior. The solution maintains compatibility across all platforms while fixing the macOS-specific issue.
Before/After
Before: TypeScript files could not be uploaded on macOS
After: TypeScript files can be uploaded and are properly handled with syntax highlighting
No UI/UX changes are introduced - this is purely a backend fix for file handling.

title: [Feature]基本功能改进建议
body:
### 功能改进建议：
**支持编辑和重新提问**
在保留上下文的情况下，允许用户对每个提问进行编辑并重新发送。这有助于避免因上下文限制导致的追问问题，提升对话效率。
**服务商 API 参数预设与自定义**
在语言模型服务商配置中，支持预设常用请求参数（如 temperature、top_p、max_tokens）。
提供自定义参数选项，允许用户添加其他个性化请求参数。
这样用户在切换模型时可以直接使用预设或自定义的参数，无需每次手动调整。
**角色配置与服务商逻辑优化**
当前角色配置功能（系统提示词、温度、上下文长度等）非常实用，但建议与服务商预设参数逻辑联动：
如果角色配置中未填写某些参数，则默认使用服务商预设值。
角色配置优先级高于服务商预设，确保灵活性和一致性。
**优化模型设置交互体验**
当前模型设置需要在开启对话后才能配置，交互流程不够直观，容易造成混乱。
建议在对话开始前提供明确的角色配置界面，允许用户提前选择或自定义角色及模型参数，从而简化操作流程并提升用户体验。

title: Inquiry Regarding Data Privacy: Does DeepChat Upload User Conversations to External Servers?
body:
Hello,

I’m currently using the DeepChat app locally with the official DeepSeek API, and I have some concerns regarding data privacy. Could you clarify if the app sends user conversations to external servers in addition to forwarding them to the API? Specifically, I want to ensure that only the necessary data is sent to DeepSeek's API and that no additional user data is uploaded to external servers for storage or analysis.

I would appreciate any clarification on this matter. Thank you!

Best regards
author: ethanAiJLu

comments.body:
Hi, we are not sending your private data to elsewhere.
All you request is fully computed local and send to your selected provider api.
And even your search query is performed full locally.

Thank you for the quick response and for clarifying that my data is processed locally without being sent elsewhere. I really appreciate the transparency and the focus on privacy.

I also want to express my gratitude for your contributions to the open-source community. It's great to see such a well-designed tool, and I’m excited to continue using DeepChat and will definitely recommend it to others!

Thanks again,
Thanks for your support, we will keep build and ship more for the community
